title: TailLAN game profile
description: Ports and instructions for sharing one game with TailLAN. See docs/adding-a-game.md.

id.description: Stable lowercase id; also the file name (<id>.json).

end.description: Inclusive end of a port range.

label.description: What the port is for: Game, Query, RCON...

ask.description: Shows the host an input (with this label) for where the game really listens, for ports that change per session.

samePort.description: Joiners must use exactly this port (the game has no port field).

lan.description: Joiners listen on all interfaces (local connections only) so LAN discovery can work.

connect.description: What joiners type in the game. Placeholders: {{host}}, {{port}}, {{port2}}..., {{hostname}}. Default {{host}}:{{port}}.

join.description: Steps for joining players; may use {{connect}} and the connect placeholders.

helpers.description: Built-in automations, e.g. minecraft-lan. See `taillan helpers`.
